dct_title_s: Soudan Mine, No. 8 Shaft, 5th Level, West, Soudan, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A map of the 5th level at the Soudan Mine starting from the No. 8 Shaft going east towards the No. 7 Shaft and weSaint The map shows the drifts, cross cuts, rock formations, raises, core sample drill holes, and stope areas. The map also shows the No. 9 Shaft and the No. 12 Shaft. Lake Superior Datum.
